decisions.reason: The offshore energy unit was given its own page and fits BSM's push into renewables; with offshore wind growing after 2021, results likely meet aspirations, and a large ship manager has the slack to carry it.
Crew and corporate travel management builds on BSM's large crew operations and gains value after COVID-era crew-change problems, so there is little shortfall to trigger dropping it.

A client vessel information portal is a low-cost digital service that supports retention of the core ship management business, and the firm's slack allows it to keep the portal while its returns remain uncertain.

The vessel performance app fits industry digitalisation and decarbonisation trends, but standalone apps are often folded into broader platforms, so it carries a somewhat higher risk of being dropped while still likely being kept.
